channel.title: Reclaim The Net – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Reclaim The Net – Bias and Credibility (reclaimthenet.org)

item.title: Ofcom Has Fined 4chan £520,000 Under a Law That Doesn't Apply in the US
item.description: The regulator issued a £520,000 fine; the lawyer replied with a picture of a hamster.

item.title: EU Proposal Links European Business Registration to Digital ID Wallets
item.description: The EU calls it a business registration tool, but the architecture looks less like a filing system and more like a foundation for something bigger.

item.title: Angela Lipps Spent 108 Days in Jail Because a Facial Recognition Algorithm Was Wrong
item.description: The software was wrong, but Angela Lipps still had to spend 108 days in a Tennessee jail proving it.

item.title: EU Admits X's Open Data Skews Disinformation Findings While Fining Platform for Restricting Researchers
item.description: The bloc that fined X for restricting researcher data access then cited X's comparatively open data as the reason it leads the disinformation statistics.

item.title: White House AI Framework Pushes Age Verification ID Mandate
item.description: Calling age verification requirements "privacy protective," is a bit like calling a honeypot "security infrastructure."

item.title: Google's Android Sideloading Will Now Require 10 Steps and a 24-Hour Wait
item.description: The ten-step process includes a mandatory 24-hour waiting period for something Android users have done with a single toggle since the platform launched.

item.title: Russia Deploys Internet Whitelist in Moscow, Blocking Foreign Sites
item.description: Moscow is the fifty-eighth region to lose access to foreign news, and St. Petersburg is next.

item.title: Blackburn's TRUMP AMERICA AI Act Repeals Section 230, Expands AI Liability, and Mandates Age Verification
item.description: The bill is framed as pro-innovation, but its actual architecture makes self-censorship and digital ID the only rational business decision for any platform that wants to survive.

item.title: The $4 Tool That Can Unmask Anonymous Accounts, and the Habits That Give You Away
item.description: The throwaway account you made years ago is sitting in a database, waiting for a system that costs less than a tank of gas to read it.

item.title: Canada's Public Safety Minister Defends Mass Surveillance Bill
item.description: The minister insists the bill targeting every Canadian's location data, movement patterns, and daily routines isn't a surveillance bill.
